"""Camera/proprioception-only controller for the single live episode.
Commands and observations are retained under /app/runs; no simulator access.
"""
import os,json,time,traceback
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
r=Robot();spec=r.spec();cams=list(spec['cameras'])
root='/app/output';log='/app/runs'
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none');counter=0

def save(res,name):
 global obs
 obs=res;res.save(log+'/'+name)
 open(root+'/latest.json','w').write(json.dumps({'path':log+'/'+name,'meta':res.meta}))
 p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']);print(name,'q',p[4:11].round(5),'eef',p[26:29].round(5),'grip',p[11:13].round(4),'time',res.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)

def move(q=None,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,steps=40,name='move'):
 p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);a=np.zeros((steps,13));a[:,0:7]=np.linspace(p[29:36],p[29:36] if q is None else q,steps);a[:,7]=p[36] if grip is None else grip;a[:,12]=mode;a[:,11]=torso
 if base is not None:a[:,8:11]=base
 res=r.submit('joint_position',a,include_depth=True,video='none',note=name);save(res,name)

save(obs,'start')
while True:
 if not os.path.exists(root+'/request.json'):time.sleep(.15);continue
 try:
  req=json.load(open(root+'/request.json'));os.unlink(root+'/request.json');counter+=1
  typ=req.pop('type');name=req.pop('name',f'run{counter:03d}')
  if typ=='move':move(name=name,**req)
  elif typ=='observe':save(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none',**req),name)
  elif typ=='calibrate':
   q0=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][4:11]);save(obs,name+'_0')
   for i in range(7):
    q=q0.copy();q[i]+=.16
    move(q=q,steps=50,name=name+'_'+str(i+1))
    move(q=q0,steps=50,name=name+'_back'+str(i+1))
  elif typ=='stop':break
  open(root+'/response.json','w').write(json.dumps({'ok':True,'name':name}))
 except Exception as e:
  traceback.print_exc();open(root+'/response.json','w').write(json.dumps({'ok':False,'error':str(e)}))
